title: I’m looking for any similarities in people who have these dreams… I’m thinking we might figure some things out if everyone could post a list of like your 3-5 favorite or most impactful books, movies, and songs. I have a feeling some patterns may emerge this way.

classification.question_topic: Requesting participants to share 3–5 favorite/most impactful books, movies, and songs, plus any out-of-the-ordinary emotionally intense life experiences, to look for patterns among people who have Mall World dreams.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative or phenomenological description; only a request for media/life-experience lists.

meta.author_theory: They suspect patterns might emerge by comparing favorite/impactful books, movies, songs, and unusual/intense life experiences among people who have these dreams.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no described dream scenes/locations/entities/sensory qualities; it is a data-gathering prompt.
